text:
marta_ops: Heads up — deploybot started a small v2 canary to eu pool-7 and we see a rise in 504s for streaming clients. Can we hold the pool? :eyes:

deploybot: roll id=rb-1818181818 initiated -> pool-7. initial rollout 5%. metric spike: status=504 on /v2/stream = 4.9% (alert threshold 1%).

jamie_releng: I'm seeing lots of backend DB compaction events scheduled on pool-7 hosts during the same window. compaction can saturate IO and cause proxy timeouts. Did infra schedule this?

raj_sre: confirmed — storage team has a rolling compaction CHG-7001 that hits pool-7 from 02:00-02:20 UTC. That overlaps our canary. If we keep rolling we might confuse canary signals. Recommend pause and either reschedule rollout or exclude maintenance hosts.

marta_ops: pausing pool-7 now: `deploybot pause rb-1818181818 --pool pool-7`

deploybot: pause acknowledged for pool-7; rollout halted for that pool, other regions unaffected.

noah_release: Quick question — do we want to pin high-volume tenants in pool-7 to v1 for the compaction window or just wait the 20min and resume? Some tenants have real-time SLAs.

olga_pm: product impact: tenants C-900 and C-901 rely on streamed transcripts; they would see degraded UX for ~20m if we wait. Better to pin them temporarily to v1 to avoid user-facing errors.

jamie_releng: alternative is to re-run canary excluding hosts scheduled for compaction: easier than pinning but riskier if those hosts are a significant portion of traffic. What's proportion?

raj_sre: compaction hosts account for ~35% of pool-7 streaming capacity. Excluding them would reduce the canary footprint and might miss a regression. Pinning top tenants is surgical.

marta_ops: let's pin top two affected tenants: `deploybot pin-tenant C-900 --api v1` and `deploybot pin-tenant C-901 --api v1` while we wait.

deploybot: tenants C-900, C-901 pinned to v1. config commit: cfg-1818a.

noah_release: I'll draft a short status message for those customers: "Temporary routing to v1 during maintenance in EU (02:00-02:20 UTC) to avoid transient timeouts. No action required." OK to send?

olga_pm: yes, please include a link to the status page and ETA to resume.

status-bot: Incident placeholder created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1818181818 — "v2 canary paused in EU pool-7 due to storage compaction overlap"

jamie_releng: ops note: when compaction finishes we should run a quick synthetic flood against pool-7 hosts to ensure no replay/backpressure after IO pressure. Also add a short buffer of 10m after maintenance before unpausing.

raj_sre: agreed. plan: wait for compaction end at 02:20, wait +10m, run 5m synthetic long-context load, check error_rate and tail `timeout_proxy` logs, then unpin tenants and resume roll at 5%. If regressions, rollback.

marta_ops: requesting approvals to pin tenants during the window — @noah_release @olga_pm please approve.

noah_release: approved. :thumbsup: 

olga_pm: approved. sending customer note now.

marta_ops: operations checklist: monitor /v2/stream 504s, tail proxy timeouts, watch queue depth and app-layer retries, prepare rollback command `deploybot rollback rb-1818181818 --region eu` (requires two approvers).

status-bot: customer note posted to tenants C-900,C-901 via email template ID tmpl-550.

jamie_releng: compaction window ended. starting 10m buffer.

raj_sre: buffer complete. starting synthetic 5m long-context load against pool-7 canaries.

marta_ops: synthetic running — 0/500 timeouts so far. continuing 3m.

deploybot: canary status: rb-1818181818-canary-01 -> runtime v2.0.2; synthetic results nominal.

jamie_releng: metrics look clean, no spike in proxy timeouts. ready to unpin and resume.

marta_ops: unpinning tenants: `deploybot unpin-tenant C-900` `deploybot unpin-tenant C-901`

deploybot: tenants C-900, C-901 unpinned.

marta_ops: resuming rollout to pool-7 at 5% -> `deploybot resume rb-1818181818 --pool pool-7 --start 5%`

deploybot: rollout resumed.

noah_release: follow-ups: add a preflight check that looks up scheduled infra changes for target pools and warns if windows overlap. Assigning to jamie_releng + raj_sre. Also add a line in release notes: "Canary paused due to storage compaction overlap; tenants temporarily pinned to v1."

jamie_releng: will add the infra overlap check to preflight.

raj_sre: will add the synthetic buffer and automated canary exclusion if maintenance detected.

olga_pm: updating release notes and status incident with final resolution.

marta_ops: closing loop. thanks team.
